title: ruellia helianthema
intro: Ruellia helianthema, commonly known as Mexican petunia, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ruellia helianthema are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Ruellia helianthema include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
